```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>CPU Temperature Dashboard</title>
    <style>
        body {
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
            margin: 20px;
        }
        canvas {
            border: 1px solid #000;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <h1>CPU Temperature Dashboard</h1>
    <canvas id="temperatureChart" width="800" height="400"></canvas>
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('temperatureChart');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        // Sample data for CPU temperature readings over seven days
        const data = {
            labels: ['Day 1', 'Day 2', 'Day 3', 'Day 4', 'Day 5', 'Day 6', 'Day 7'],
            temperatures: [45, 50, 55, 60, 65, 70, 75]
        };

        // Function to draw the chart
        function drawChart() {
            const padding = 50;
            const chartWidth = canvas.width - 2 * padding;
            const chartHeight = canvas.height - 2 * padding;

            // Clear the canvas
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

            // Draw the axes
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(padding, padding);
            ctx.lineTo(padding, canvas.height - padding);
            ctx.lineTo(canvas.width - padding, canvas.height - padding);
            ctx.stroke();

            // Draw the labels for the axes
            ctx.fillText('Temperature (°C)', padding - 40, padding - 10);
            ctx.fillText('Days', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height - padding + 30);

            // Draw the temperature labels on the y-axis
            const tempRange = 85 - 40;
            const tempStep = tempRange / 5;
            for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i++) {
                const temp = 40 + i * tempStep;
                const y = canvas.height - padding - (i * (chartHeight / 5));
                ctx.fillText(temp.toString(), padding - 30, y + 5);
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(padding - 5, y);
                ctx.lineTo(padding, y);
                ctx.stroke();
            }

            // Draw the day labels on the x-axis
            data.labels.forEach((label, index) => {
                const x = padding + (index + 1) * (chartWidth / (data.labels.length + 1));
                ctx.fillText(label, x - 20, canvas.height - padding + 20);
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(x, canvas.height - padding);
                ctx.lineTo(x, canvas.height - padding + 5);
                ctx.stroke();
            });

            // Draw the temperature line
            ctx.beginPath();
            data.temperatures.forEach((temp, index) => {
                const x = padding + (index + 1) * (chartWidth / (data.labels.length + 1));
                const y = canvas.height - padding - ((temp - 40) / tempRange) * chartHeight;
                if (index === 0) {
                    ctx.moveTo(x, y);
                } else {
                    ctx.lineTo(x, y);
                }
            });
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'blue';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.stroke();

            // Draw the data points
            data.temperatures.forEach((temp, index) => {
                const x = padding + (index + 1) * (chartWidth / (data.labels.length + 1));
                const y = canvas.height - padding - ((temp - 40) / tempRange) * chartHeight;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(x, y, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fillStyle = 'blue';
                ctx.fill();
            });
        }

        // Initial draw
        drawChart();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```
